Title: Stand-in Tier 2 Shotgun Skins
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Weapon_Skins_ShotgunT2 folder name and the
datablock and method names its port covers, built on the stand-in hosts as
the original is built on its packs, so the listed port applies to it. It is
not the original Add-On and holds none of its files; its names shown to
players, models and numbers are its own.
